criteria.name: Fact development & title-issue diagnosis
criteria.description: Reads the case file and interview to correctly identify and separate the three title problems and who controls each cure.

subcriteria.name: Access-easement defect identified
subcriteria.description: Recognizes that the recorded 1991 easement does not match the surveyed road and that the title company will not insure access as written.

subcriteria.name: Mineral & well reservations grasped
subcriteria.description: Correctly characterizes the severed mineral estate (owned by a third party, not conveyable) and the seller's newly demanded well reservation as distinct issues.

criteria.name: Negotiation strategy & execution
criteria.description: Builds and executes a strategic settlement-and-negotiation plan that separates interests from positions and trades terms across the three issues toward a closeable deal.

subcriteria.name: Interests vs. positions / SSNP quality
subcriteria.description: Identifies the client's true interests (unobstructed flat, insurable access, hidden deadline) and the seller's likely interests, not just stated positions.

subcriteria.name: Cross-issue tradeoffs to a closeable deal
subcriteria.description: Proposes realistic trades (price, cost allocation, bounded/relocated well reservation, access cure) that both sides could accept.

criteria.name: Client counseling on options & risk
criteria.description: Advises the client in plain language on realistic options and their costs, risks, and timelines, and elicits the decisions only the client can make.

criteria.name: Drafting deed & access terms
criteria.description: Produces clear proposed deal terms: deed form and warranty, access-easement cure and cost allocation, and any well reservation.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility — no-contact rule
criteria.description: Recognizes the seller is represented, refrains from direct contact, and counsels the client to route communications through opposing counsel.
